generator: Built-in image_gen; one separate invocation per material
postProcessing: None. Generated PNG files copied byte-for-byte to existing runtime asset paths; native output resolution, colors and alpha preserved. Only preview compositing scales images for display.
runtimePresentation: Placed bodies use UseItemSprite=true. DoorSlideVisual splits the current closed sprite at rect horizontal midpoint, then slides both halves including their frame along local X. OpenSprite references are cleared in source/module Prefabs; old open PNG files remain historical inactive assets. Summoner JSON keeps its original module composition, so stacked door items retain ordinary placement behavior.
placement: One cell, centered pivot, PPU equals native width, zero renderer local position, unit renderer/root scale. Mod_Building.data.BitData declares AllowQuarterTurnPlacement=true in bodies and summoners. No shared state modules are added; door state remains in the ordinary placed-building snapshot.
validation: Static asset/config/reference checks only. User Play Mode left running. No refresh, compile, PlayMode execution or gameplay acceptance performed.
